rows.quote: This study used a genome-wide association study (GWAS)-by-subtraction approach to separate genetic effects specific to OA from those shared with BMI, using GWAS of 12 OA traits from the Genetics of Osteoarthritis Consortium.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names GWAS of 12 OA traits from the Genetics of Osteoarthritis Consortium; no dictionary outcome row for it.
